context.title: San Francisco Climate Emergency Coalition: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition B (Establishing a Municipal Finance Corporation and a Public Bank)

positions.statement: San Francisco Climate Emergency Coalition signed the argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition B and the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition B in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition G (Allowing Private Vehicles on the Great Highway in Sunset Dunes Park)

positions.statement: San Francisco Climate Emergency Coalition signed the paid argument against San Francisco Proposition G in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.
